#!/bin/bash
#FLUX --job-name=score_radio_g01_3    # job name
#FLUX --ntasks=1                   # number of MP tasks
#FLUX --ntasks-per-node=1          # number of MPI tasks per node
#FLUX --gpus=1                 # number of GPUs per node
#FLUX --cpus-per-task=10           # number of cores per tasks
# NOTE: The SLURM hint '--hint=nomultithread' has been omitted as there is no
# direct Flux equivalent. Flux's default binding may utilize SMT/hyper-threading
# if available, which could have performance implications if the workload is
# sensitive to it.
# NOTE: The SLURM '--distribution=block:block' option has been omitted. Flux's
# default task mapping should provide good performance. If specific placement
# is required, 'flux run --map-procs' can be used, but this could have
# performance implications if not set correctly.
#FLUX --time=20:00:00               # maximum execution time (HH:MM:SS)
#FLUX --output=score_radio_g01_3{id}.out   # output file name
#FLUX --error=score_radio_g01_3{id}.out    # error file name


module purge
module load tensorflow-gpu/py3/1.15.2

set -x

export PYTHONPATH="$PYTHONPATH:$WORK/GitHub/alpha-transform"
export PYTHONPATH="$PYTHONPATH:$WORK/GitHub/score"

cd $WORK/GitHub/ShapeDeconv/scripts/score/score_radio_g01

python ./score_radio_g01_3.py

issues: The script relies on a custom environment variable `$WORK` to define several crucial paths (for `PYTHONPATH` and the working directory). If this variable is not set in the job's environment, the script will fail with 'file not found' errors.
The script sets the same file for both standard output and standard error. While this is valid, it can make debugging more difficult as error messages will be interleaved with normal program output.

#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=score_radio_g01_3    # job name
#SBATCH --ntasks=1                   # number of MP tasks
#SBATCH --ntasks-per-node=1          # number of MPI tasks per node
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:1                 # number of GPUs per node
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=10           # number of cores per tasks
# /!\ Caution, in the following line, "multithread" refers to hyperthreading.
#SBATCH --hint=nomultithread         # we get physical cores not logical
#SBATCH --distribution=block:block   # we pin the tasks on contiguous cores
#SBATCH --time=20:00:00               # maximum execution time (HH:MM:SS)
#SBATCH --output=score_radio_g01_3%j.out   # output file name
#SBATCH --error=score_radio_g01_3%j.out    # error file name


module purge
module load tensorflow-gpu/py3/1.15.2

set -x

export PYTHONPATH="$PYTHONPATH:$WORK/GitHub/alpha-transform"
export PYTHONPATH="$PYTHONPATH:$WORK/GitHub/score"

cd $WORK/GitHub/ShapeDeconv/scripts/score/score_radio_g01

python ./score_radio_g01_3.py
